_about: Persona and memory as an add-on (2026-10-26): trained on top of g26 (the timing adapter, folded in frozen), on persona calls only (g26m8's calls, the rest at weight 0, so g26m8's cache serves), and played together with it in the app at scale 1 each. In the memory runs 75% of the training signal was what it says, so every persona change moved g26's timing; here g26 keeps the timing and the add-on only learns what g26 lacks: the friend's words with a persona, memory moments, nudges and keeping quiet after an unanswered one. Its other listening ticks weigh nothing. g26m8's persona calls (300 new, the earlier ones with varied refusals), the memory spread, weights 10/3 and 6/2, cosine decay. The listening ticks of persona calls keep 0.3 of their weight (an add-on trained only on speaking drifts eager, and eagerness goes with playing along); tested blended at add-on scale 1 (and 0.5 by hand). Before it (2026-10-26): the bare base model, asked the memory test's false claims in plain chat with the persona prompt, declined none (played along 12 of 20), so declining has to be taught; g26 with one BOS played along 11 of 16, g26m8 also 11 (its varied refusals were too faint at 10/3 among all its calls; here only persona calls carry signal).
name: g26p
